scientific_limitations: Finite simple regular binary plant-pollinator incidence networks; uniformly random fixed-size deletion of pollinators; coextinction only after all partners lost. No extrapolation to real network architectures, alternative extinction rules, rewiring, or dynamical persistence. Relevant stochastic-block-model source had only abstract-level access for the final comparison.
title: Projective-plane pollination webs minimize coextinction variability at every random-loss stage
